source: Acadia-Configuration hq_command_handler.rs (device-local verbs of the `configuration` pseudo-daemon)

operations.name: backup
operations.description: Capture the redacted device backup and upload it to HQ.

operations.name: restore
operations.description: Restore a previously uploaded device backup.

operations.name: factory_reset
operations.description: Reset device settings; reboots after the outcome is acknowledged.

operations.name: apply_update
operations.description: Download, SHA-256-verify and install a signed update to the inactive slot.

operations.name: configuration.read
operations.description: Read the device configuration document (contract v1).

operations.name: configuration.write
operations.description: Ed25519-signed configuration write; merges, applies and reports per-applier outcomes.

operations.name: system.reboot
operations.description: Reboot the device (executed after the outcome is acknowledged).

operations.name: update.reboot_to_apply
operations.description: Tryboot into the freshly installed slot.

operations.name: update.rollback
operations.description: Re-arm the previous slot and reboot.

operations.name: log_bundle.request
operations.description: Create a logmanager support bundle and upload it to HQ.

operations.name: users.delete
operations.description: Delete a local web-UI account (last-admin guarded).

operations.name: users.set_role
operations.description: Change a local web-UI account's role.
